decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with its own page fits the firm's accessories business, costs little to keep, and supports after-sales revenue.
Box trailer series are core products for this type of car trailer maker, and this one was shown on the home page as a key offering.
Car transporters serve professional users and dealers, a stable niche that complements the range, even though it has less prominence than the home page products.
The low-bed series is a core volume product shown on the home page and fits the firm's emphasis on efficient production.
High covers are popular add-ons that extend the trailer range, and this series was shown on the home page in its launch year.
A second box trailer series likely targets a different price or size segment and was featured on the home page, so dropping it after one year is unlikely, though some overlap with B exists.
